Hadhrat Umar (RA) Delivers a Lecture Preventing people from Making Dowries Expensive and from openly stating who is a Martyr

Hadhrat Ibnul Ajfaa reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once said the following in his lecture: "Take note that you should not inflate the dowries of your women because had this been an act of honour in this world and an act of Taqwa in Allaah's sight, Nabi ﷺ would have been most entitled to it. However, Rasulullaah ﷺ never gave any of his wives a dowry of more than twelve Awqiya and did not receive more than this as dowry for any of his daughters either. What is happening is that some of you inflate the dowry so much that the husband (when unable to pay) fosters hatred for her in his heart, saying, 'It is because of you that I have been burdened with a water-bag hung around my neck.' Another aspect I wish to discuss is that when someone is killed in your battles, you say that he has been killed as a martyr or has died as a martyr. However, it is very possible that in the interests of conducting trade, he has stored away some gold or silver at the back of his animal or in his carriage. You should therefore not make such bold statements but rather say what Rasulullaah ﷺ used to say; 'Whoever is killed or dies in the path of Allaah shall be in Jannah.'"[^2]

Hadhrat Masrooq narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once mounted the pulpit and said, "O people! What is this inflation of dowries for your women when the dowries common amongst Rasulullaah ﷺ and his Sahabah (RA) were in the region of four hundred Dirhams and less. Had inflated dowries been a sign of Taqwa in Allaah's sight or a mark of honour, you people would have never beaten Rasulullaah ﷺ and his Sahabah (RA) to it (they would have been first to implement it)."[^3]
Some versions of this lecture have already been quoted in the chapter discussing marriage.
